highlights.title: Sign in again and the work carries on
highlights.text: When a connection needs you to sign in again, signing in closes its "needs you" line for every bot, and each chat it stopped carries on once, by itself.

highlights.title: A connection a bot suggested picks up the request
highlights.text: Connect a server a bot suggested and that chat carries on with the request it was for. Deleting a connection closes its open lines as "Removed."
